decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be maintained out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Location Plan, 16/25/SRB/101-OUTB Received 11/04/16) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The outbuidling hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 25 Springvale Avenue, Brentford.
description: Retrospective application for the erection of a detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house.
